items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: And with Wingy leading them, they were New Orleans bands.

ctx.x: Connon denies that, of course. But I think that's just because Connon doesn't like tags on anything. Uh. Uh, to me there always has been. I think it's as definable as, let's say, Kansas City, certainly.
If not. Uh, still, there was a little crossing here. For example, Wingy's bands might be called Chicago bands. And with Wingy leading them, they were New Orleans bands.
